page_summary: This page provides a detailed list of tables and boxes included in the report. The tables cover topics such as regulation elements for critical infrastructure, survey respondents by income level, common cyber incident entry points in ports, and additional cybersecurity resources. The boxes highlight various case studies, research approaches, cybersecurity considerations within the ISPS Code, governance mechanisms, network segmentation, business continuity planning, training methods, collaboration efforts, return on security investment, and cybersecurity collaboration networks.
